full_prompt_en: A square folk art illustration places two mirrored colorful birds among densely packed flowers against a black background. A narrow turquoise dotted border runs around the whole panel, followed by a darker inner line that contains the design. The birds face one another at the center, their cream heads and round eyes turned inward. Each body carries repeating bands of red, teal, yellow, and blue ornament, while wide wings lift outward in layered feathers of bright yellow, coral pink, and deep blue. Their long lower tail feathers angle toward the corners, adding a strong diagonal rhythm. Above the pair, a large golden orange sunflower with a dark circular center occupies the top middle. Smaller turquoise and yellow blooms sit in the upper corners, balanced by red rosettes, pink spirals, and tiny green leaves throughout the remaining black field. Beneath the birds, slender curling stems frame a central red flower and a little ocher circular form near the bottom edge. Additional yellow and blue blossoms fit into the lower corners, leaving almost no unpainted space inside the border. The shapes are flat and deliberately outlined, but tiny dots, short curved strokes, and repeated color bands make each area feel handmade and varied. Light is even and decorative rather than directional, so the black ground remains uniformly deep while every bright color stays clear. The overall composition is exuberantly symmetrical, balancing a central pair with radial flowers and a dense border of small patterned accents.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形民间艺术插画把两只镜像彩鸟放在密集花朵间，背景为黑色。窄窄的青绿色点状边框围住整幅画，内侧另有一条深色细线将设计收住。两鸟在中央相向，奶油色头部和圆眼都朝内。各自身体带有红、青绿、黄、蓝色的重复装饰带，宽阔双翼向外抬起，由亮黄、珊瑚粉和深蓝的层叠羽毛组成。较长的下部尾羽朝画角倾斜，形成有力的斜向节奏。两鸟上方，一朵有深色圆心的大金橙色向日葵占据顶部中央。较小的青绿黄花位于上角，红色圆花、粉色螺旋和细小绿叶则填满其余黑色场域。鸟下方，细卷茎条框住一朵中央红花以及底边附近一枚小赭色圆形。额外的黄蓝花朵嵌在下角，使边框内几乎没有空白。形状平坦且有意勾边，微小点痕、短曲线和重复彩带却让每个区域显得手作而多变。光均匀而装饰化，不按方向照射，因此黑色底面始终深沉，每种亮色也保持清楚。整体构图欢腾而对称，以中央一组图形平衡放射式纹样和细小花纹重音构成的密集边框。
style_prompt_en: Folk art illustration fills a square black field with highly saturated red, golden yellow, turquoise, coral pink, leaf green, and deep blue shapes. Mirrored organization gives the central forms an immediate rhythm, while smaller curling lines, dots, and radial motifs fill nearly every surrounding gap. A narrow repeating border seals the pattern and keeps the dense interior from spilling outward. Flat color areas are bounded by dark or contrasting outlines, yet handworked irregularity remains in the tiny strokes and uneven decorative repeats. Larger bright shapes anchor top and center, and smaller warm and cool accents alternate toward the corners. Light is even and nonillusionistic; the colors read through their value and hue separation rather than cast shadow or deep perspective. The black ground provides continuous negative space in tiny channels between the dense marks. The overall effect is festive and emphatic, with strong symmetry held lively by small variations in the painted detail.
style_prompt_zh: 民间艺术插画用高度饱和的红、金黄、青绿、珊瑚粉、叶绿和深蓝形状填满方形黑底。镜像组织给中央形体立即可辨的节奏，较小的卷线、点痕和放射纹样填充几乎所有周围缝隙。窄窄的重复边框封住图案，避免密集内部向外溢出。平色色面由深色或对比色轮廓界定，微小笔触和不均匀的装饰重复仍保留手作变化。较大的亮形支撑上部与中心，较小冷暖重音向角落交替。光均匀而不制造幻觉；色彩靠明度与色相分离显现，而非投影或深透视。黑底在密集痕迹之间的小通道里提供连续留白。整体效果喜庆而鲜明，强对称通过绘画细节里的小变化保持活力。
theme_en: Mirrored colorful birds and flowers in a Ukrainian folk art square
theme_zh: 乌克兰民间艺术方画中的对称彩鸟与花朵
name: Ukrainian folk art
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
